channel.title: The Assam Tribune - Article Feed
channel.description: Latest articles from The Assam Tribune (assamtribune.com)

item.title: First-level checking of EVMs, VVPATs completed in 34 districts
item.description: The exercise was carried out from December 11 to January 9.

item.title: Centre receives Assam govt proposal seeking ST status for six communities
item.description: The proposals are examined by the office of the Registrar General of India and then by the National Commission for Scheduled Tribes: Union Minister Durgadas Uikey

item.title: Traffic chaos grips city as Chandmari flyover lanes shut without warning
item.description: Daily commuters, office-goers and people returning home were caught mid-journey, crawling at a snail’s pace or stuck in standstill traffic.

item.title: Vigilance & public support prevent train–elephant collision risk at Deepor Beel
item.description: During 2025 alone, forest personnel intervened eight times to prevent potential train-elephant collisions.

item.title: Manipur government to resettle over 10,000 displaced families by March 31
item.description: The primary aim of the Government is to gradually and securely rehabilitate IDPs, restore stable living conditions, and enable resumption of livelihoods, education and normal community life.

item.title: Political uncertainty in Lai ADC ends as C Lalsawmzuala wins floor test
item.description: Lalsawmzuala won the House’s backing with the support of 15 MDCs in the 25-member council, while nine members voted against him.

item.title: ISIS-K threat in Meghalaya: State body writes to PM Modi seeking central probe
item.description: CoMSO chairman Roykupar Synrem demanded immediate involvement of counter-terror and intelligence agencies and a comprehensive investigation into the origin.

item.title: Traffic Chaos Grips Guwahati as Chandmari Flyover Lanes Shut Without Warning
item.description: Traffic Chaos Grips Guwahati as Chandmari Flyover Lanes Shut Without Warning

item.title: Residents’ outcry grows as Silsako digging chokes neighbourhoods
item.description: The apparent lack of coordination among the GMDA, traffic authorities & environmental monitoring agencies reflects poor planning and weak on-ground supervision, the residents stated.

item.title: APL, Deendayal Port sign MoU to set up Rs 1,200 Cr green methanol plant in Gujarat
item.description: The project will involve a joint capital investment from APL & DPA and is expected to generate around 3,500 employment opportunities
